30:
Davan the Woodsman was a quite Sholtar who lived just outside of a small town a short time after the Spellblaze. He kept to himself a lot and meticulously tended his traps and other work.
	When the first wave of sickness from the Spellblaze went through the town, Davan was unaffected and provided free game to those who were too sick to work themselves. As years past, the diseases kept coming and people kept getting sick and dying, but not Davan.
	In other times, he would have been praised for his kindness and generosity, but this wasn't other times, this was the time of the Spellhunt. Jealous tongues wagged and rumours of magic spread. Soon the Spellhunt came to town.
	Davan showed them his home, that it was free of magic and explained that his life in the woods was what made him healthy. But hate and suspicion had joined jealousy and soon a magical talisman was found in the woods near his house.
	Wood was collected for a pyre and in a last attempt to clear his name, Davan uttered a curse against all mages. They tied him to the pyre and it lit it anyway. But flames didn't seem to be burning him as fast as expected. The crowd saw this as evidence of magic. Davan thought that the Spellhunters were deliberately torturing him. He started to utter another curse against all spellhunters, but one threw a knife which caught the curse in his throat, killing him.
	In the ashes the next morning, his armour and the knife were found intact. Completely untouched by the flames, but not unaffected by his curses. He was afterall, meticulous in his work.
